entities.name: unilateral pain plus unilateral cranial autonomic symptoms

relationships.subject: unilateral pain plus unilateral cranial autonomic symptoms
relationships.evidence_quote: The ≥50% response (primary endpoint) in HFEM was positively associated with unilateral pain (UP) + unilateral cranial autonomic symptoms (UAs) (OR:4.23, 95%CI:1.57-11.4; p = 0.004)

relationships.subject: obesity
relationships.evidence_quote: Obesity emerged as a negative predictor of antiCGRP mAbs responsiveness in patients with CM.

key_findings: In 864 migraine patients, unilateral pain plus cranial autonomic symptoms predicted >=50% and >=75% response to anti-CGRP mAbs in HFEM; in CM, UAs and UP plus allodynia predicted response and obesity predicted non-response.
Pain features indicating peripheral or central sensitization may enable mechanism-based migraine treatment selection.
